blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image editing models produce impressive results for individual edits, but their quality often deteriorates over multiple editing turns. Each editing turn introduces small distribution shifts that accumulate over successive edits, creating a gap between the input distributions encountered during the editor's original training and multi-turn inference. We introduce a training scheme that makes multi-turn image editing stable under this accumulating distribution shift. A key is to force the editor to operate on its own outputs from previous editing turns during training, bringing the principle of Self-Forcing to image editing. The main challenge is that self-generated editing trajectories deviate from ground-truth trajectories, making direct supervision unreliable. We address this challenge through a distillation objective that leverages a teacher image editor to provide a reliable training signal when the model operates on its own previous outputs. We introduce an asymmetric conditioning scheme: while the student performs edits sequentially on its own outputs, the teacher remains anchored to the original clean image and receives a compound editing instruction. Experiments show substantially reduced degradation over long multi-turn sequences while maintaining editing quality and instruction adherence.
blocks.zh: 图像编辑模型为个人编辑带来了令人印象深刻的结果,但其质量往往会因为多个编辑转折而恶化. 每个编辑回合都引入了在相继编辑后相继积累的小型发行分班,在编辑员原始训练期间遇到的输入分班和多回合推论之间造成了差距. 我们推行了一项培训计划,在这种累积的分布转变下,使多回合图像编辑稳定。 一个关键是迫使编辑者在训练期间根据之前的编辑回合的自己产出进行操作,将"自强"原则带入图像编辑. 主要挑战在于自发产生的编辑轨迹偏离了地上真实轨迹,使得直接监管不可靠. 我们通过一个提炼目标来应对这一挑战,该目标利用教师图像编辑器,在模型按自己以往产出运作时提供可靠的培训信号。 我们引入了一个不对称的调节方案:虽然学生根据自己的产出依次进行编辑,但教师仍然固定在原始的清洁图像上,并接受复合编辑指导。 实验表明,在长期多回合序列中,降解程度大大降低,同时保持了编辑质量和指令的坚持性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image editing with modern generative models has reached an impressive level of quality, enabling complex modifications while faithfully preserving the appearance and content of the input image [ 26 , 49 , 44 , 6 , 24 ] .
Yet, practical editing is rarely a single operation.
Users often refine an image through a sequence of edits, where the output of one edit becomes the input to the next.
This setting is commonly referred to as multi-turn image editing .
With current image editing models, each editing turn introduces small distribution shifts that accumulate as the model repeatedly operates on its own outputs.
These shifts create a growing gap between the input distributions encountered during the editor’s original training and multi-turn inference.
This gap leads to accumulating artifacts, loss of fine details, and unintended changes in appearance (see Figure 1 ).
Effective image editing therefore requires not only high-quality individual edits, but also stability across successive editing turns.
blocks.zh:
以现代基因模型编辑的图像达到了令人印象深刻的质量水平,能够进行复杂的修改,同时忠实地保留了输入图像的外观和内容[26,49,44,6,24].
然而,实际编辑很少是单一操作.
用户经常通过一系列编辑来完善一幅图像,其中一幅编辑的输出会成为下一幅的输入.
此设置通常称为多回合图像编辑 。
以目前的图像编辑模型,每个编辑回合都引入了小的发行转移,随着模型在自身输出上反复运行而积累.
这些转变在编辑最初的培训过程中遇到的输入分配和多回合推论之间造成了越来越大的差距.
这一差距导致文物的积累、细微细节的丢失和外观的意外变化(见图1)。
因此,有效的图像编辑不仅需要高质量的个人编辑,而且需要连续的编辑回合的稳定性。

blocks.en:
Several approaches have been proposed to mitigate degradation in multi-turn image editing.
Inference-time methods target specific sources of degradation [ 62 , 27 , 38 , 47 ] , but may incur computational overhead and are limited by the complexity of distribution shifts in multi-turn editing.
Other approaches train models on multi-turn editing sequences [ 39 , 52 , 16 , 61 ] .
Training on ground-truth sequences leaves a gap between training and inference, while training on self-generated sequences poses supervision challenges, leading to inconsistent targets, restrictions on training sequences, or objectives that do not explicitly address distribution shifts.
blocks.zh:
在多轮图像编辑中,提出了若干减少退化的方法。
推论时间方法针对特定的退化源[62,27,38,47],但可能涉及计算间接费用,并受到多回合编辑中分布变化的复杂性所限制.
其他方法在多回合编辑序列上训练模型[39,52,16,61].
关于地面真实序列的培训在培训与推论之间留下了空白,而关于自行生成序列的培训则构成监督挑战,导致目标不一致,培训序列受到限制,或者目标没有明确涉及分配转移。

blocks.en:
We present a training scheme for multi-turn image editing that maintains stability under accumulating distribution shifts.
Our scheme is inspired by autoregressive video generation, where models similarly operate on their own outputs and face accumulating distribution shifts.
Following the principle of Self-Forcing [ 17 ] , we train the editor on its own outputs from previous editing turns, allowing it to learn from the distribution shifts encountered during multi-turn inference.
However, self-generated editing trajectories inevitably deviate from ground-truth trajectories, making direct supervision with ground-truth images unreliable.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个多回合图像编辑的培训计划,在不断积累的分期分配过程中保持稳定性。
我们的计划受到自相递进的视频生成的启发,其中的模型同样运行在自己的输出上,并面临不断积累的发行转变.
遵循"自强出〔17〕"的原则,我们从之前的编辑回合对编辑者进行自己的产出培训,使其能从多回合推论中遇到的分布变化中学习.
然而,自我生成的编辑轨迹不可避免地偏离了地上真实轨迹,使得地上真实图像的直接监督不可靠.

blocks.en:
To address this challenge, we employ score distillation in a teacher-student framework to train the editor on its self-generated trajectories without requiring ground-truth targets for its intermediate outputs [ 37 , 48 , 57 ] .
We introduce an asymmetric conditioning scheme for the student and teacher.
The student’s input may already deviate significantly from the teacher’s training distribution, making it unsuitable for reliable teacher guidance.
We therefore condition the teacher on the original image and a compound instruction combining all edits up to the current turn, while the student performs edits sequentially on its own outputs.
This provides a training signal that reflects the intended edits without inheriting the errors accumulated along the student’s trajectory.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这一挑战,我们在师生框架内采用分分法,对编辑进行自发轨迹的培训,而无需为其中间产出设定地面真实目标[37、48、57]。
我们为学生和教师引入了一个不对称的调节方案。
学生的投入可能已经大大偏离了教师的培训分配,因此不适合可靠的教师指导。
因此,我们规定教师必须使用原始图像和复合教学,将所有编辑合并到目前的轮回,而学生则根据自己的产出按顺序进行编辑。
这提供了一种训练信号,在不继承学生在轨迹上所累积的错误的情况下,反映预定的编辑。

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method against existing multi-turn image editing approaches and demonstrate significant qualitative and quantitative improvements in preserving editing capabilities while mitigating accumulated distribution drift.
Our training is efficient and introduces no inference-time overhead, while making no assumptions about the nature of distribution shifts or restrictions on editing sequences.
Through ablation studies, we further demonstrate the importance of our asymmetric conditioning scheme for stable multi-turn editing.
blocks.zh:
我们对照现有的多回合图像编辑方法来评价我们的方法,并显示出在维持编辑能力方面在质量和数量上的重大改进,同时减少累积的分发漂移。
我们的培训效率高,没有引入推断时间间接费用,同时对分配轮班的性质或对编辑序列的限制不作假设。
通过减肥研究,我们进一步证明了我们的不对称调节计划对于稳定多轮编辑的重要性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early text-driven manipulation largely steered pre-trained GAN latent spaces via vision-language models [ 36 , 11 ] .
The advent of diffusion models broadened semantic coverage and synthesized complex scenes more flexibly.
Subsequent approaches improved source-image preservation and fine-grained control through noise perturbation and trajectory inversion [ 33 , 34 , 46 , 19 , 5 , 10 ] , alongside spatial blending and cross-attention steering [ 3 , 14 , 7 , 45 , 1 ] .
Recent efforts extend inference-time control to continuous-time flow models through structural layer control [ 4 ] , flow inversion [ 40 , 20 ] , inversion-free sampling trajectories [ 23 ] , and text-embedding control for continuous editing [ 21 , 18 ] .
Complementing inference-time methods, instruction-tuned architectures learn a direct mapping using synthetic pairs [ 6 ] , human annotations [ 59 ] , and multi-task supervision [ 13 , 42 ] .
Emerging state-of-the-art transformer-based diffusion and flow backbones further push visual quality and compositional reasoning, demonstrating unprecedented instruction fidelity and fine-grained spatial control [ 26 , 50 , 49 , 25 ] .
Despite these single-step capabilities, isolated edit accuracy does not prevent error propagation, identity degradation, or semantic drift when applied iteratively across extended editing sequences.
blocks.zh:
早期由文字驱动的操纵主要通过视觉语言模型引导预先训练的GAN潜在空间[36,11].
传播模型的出现扩大了语义的涵盖范围并更灵活地综合了复杂的场景.
后续办法通过噪音扰动和轨迹倒置,改进了源图像保存和精细控制[33、34、46、19、5、10],同时改进了空间混合和跨视向导[3、14、7、45、1]。
最近的努力通过结构层控制[4],流量倒置[40,20],无倒置采样轨迹[23],以及连续编辑的文本嵌入控制[21,18],将推断时间控制扩展到了连续时间流出模型.
补充推论-时间方法,指导-调结构学使用合成对子[6],人文注释[59],多任务监督[13,42].
新兴最先进的变压器传播和流干线进一步推进视觉质量和构成推理,展现出前所未有的指令忠诚和精细的空间控制[26,50,49,25].
尽管有这些单步能力,但孤立的编辑精度并不能防止在跨扩展编辑序列进行迭接应用时发生错误传播,身份退化或语义漂移.

blocks.en:
Maintaining image quality and content consistency across successive edits is a central challenge in multi-turn image editing, as errors can accumulate over the editing sequence.
Agentic frameworks tackle this challenge through planning, memory, and reflection [ 41 , 54 ] , while training-free methods improve consistency through inversion and attention control [ 62 ] , high-frequency feature preservation [ 27 ] , inversion sharing [ 38 ] , and low-frequency latent alignment [ 47 ] .
Other approaches learn sequential editing directly: VINCIE learns in-context editing from video-derived sequences [ 39 ] , while AnchorEdit combines supervised causal multi-turn training with self-generated histories and identity-anchoring memory [ 52 ] .
Reinforcement learning methods optimize trajectory-level editing rewards [ 16 ] or jointly optimize history-dependent reasoning and image generation [ 55 ] .
More recently, MT-OPSD distills clean-conditioned editing behavior onto states generated through identity-edit rollouts [ 61 ] , which accumulate errors while keeping the intended content fixed.
Our training instead follows the editing process as it unfolds during inference: successive semantic edits with evolving content and preservation requirements.
Through distribution matching, we align the student’s evolving output distribution, modeled by a learned auxiliary editor, with the target distribution defined by a teacher conditioned on the original image and cumulative instructions, without paired intermediate targets.
blocks.zh:
保持相继编辑的图像质量和内容一致性,是多回合图像编辑中的一项中心挑战,因为错误可能会在编辑序列上累积.
代理框架通过规划、内存和反思[41、54]来应对这一挑战,而无培训方法则通过反向和注意力控制[62]、高频特征保存[27]、反向共享[38]和低频潜在对接[47]来提高一致性。
其他方法直接学习相继编辑:VINCIE从视频出自的序列中学习了内文本编辑[39];而AnchorEdit则将受监督的因果多转会训练与自发历史和身份识别记忆相结合[52].
强化学习方法优化轨迹级编辑奖励[16]或联合优化历史依赖推理和图像生成[55].
最近,MT-OPSD在通过身份编辑推出生成的状态上提炼出干净的有条件的编辑行为[61],在保持预定内容固定的同时积累出错误.
相反,我们的培训是在推论期间展开的编辑过程之后进行的:连续的语义编辑,内容和保存要求不断演变。
通过分配比对,我们使由学习辅助编辑所建模的学生不断演变的产出分布与教师根据原始图像和累积指示所定义的目标分布一致,而不配对中间目标.

blocks.zh: 3 序言: 分数抖动

Some of these works have identified the high variance associated with subtracting the sampled noise ϵ \epsilon from the model’s prediction as a contributing factor.
In particular, Variational Score Distillation (VSD) [ 48 ] addresses this issue by replacing the sampled noise ϵ \epsilon subtracted from the model’s prediction with the prediction of an auxiliary model ϵ LoRA \epsilon_{\mathrm{LoRA}} fine-tuned on images produced by G G .

Noise-Free Score Distillation (NFSD) [ 22 ] provides a new interpretation of score distillation.

Under this interpretation, subtracting the auxiliary prediction in VSD approximately cancels the denoising component, leaving the directions associated with condition alignment and domain correction to guide optimization.

blocks.en:
While SDS and VSD optimize individual instances for a given prompt, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) [ 57 , 56 ] extends this approach to training a generative model.
DMD uses the VSD loss to train a student model, guided by a pretrained diffusion model referred to as the teacher .
The student learns to generate images for arbitrary prompts.
Our method adopts this teacher–student formulation for training a stable editor.
blocks.zh:
虽然SDS和VSD优化了特定快件的单个实例,但分配匹配分馏(DMD)[57,56]将这种方法扩展至培训基因模型.
DMD使用VSD损失来训练一个学生模型, 以预训传播模型为指导,
学生学习生成图像用于任意的提示.
我们的方法是采用这种师生配方来培养稳定编辑。

blocks.en: Although these methods were originally formulated for noise-predicting diffusion models, score distillation can also be applied to flow-matching models [ 17 ] . This extension relies on converting predicted flow velocities into score estimates. We adopt this formulation in our method.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些方法最初是为噪声预测扩散模型而拟定的,但分数蒸馏也可以被应用于流相匹配模型 [17]. 这一扩展依赖于将预测的流量速度转换为分数估计. 我们采用这种方法。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
Image editing models are typically trained on pairs of input and target images [ 26 ] .
However, in multi-turn editing, the model repeatedly receives inputs generated by its own previous predictions, which it was not trained to handle.
This creates a train–test gap that can cause errors and artifacts to accumulate over successive edits.
blocks.zh:
图像编辑模型一般在对输入和目标图像[26]上被训练.
然而,在多回合编辑中,该模型反复接收由自己之前的预测所生成的输入,没有经过处理训练.
这造成了一个列车测试漏洞,它会让错误和文物通过相继的编辑来积累.

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we train our multi-turn image editing model G θ G_{\theta} to edit images produced by repeatedly applying the model itself, as illustrated in Figure 2 .
We refer to the resulting sequences of edited images as rollouts.
Supervising the model on these rollouts is challenging even when a ground-truth editing sequence is available.
Since an edit can have many valid outcomes, the model’s output at a given turn may differ from the corresponding ground-truth image, even if the edit was applied correctly.
As a result, subsequent edits in the rollout are applied to images that differ from those in the ground-truth sequence.
Therefore, the ground-truth images cannot serve as paired targets for supervising these edits.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们培训了我们的多回合图像编辑模型G Q Q_{\theta 来编辑通过反复应用模型本身产生的图像,如图2所示。
我们把由此产生的经过编辑的图像序列称为推出。
即便有了地面真实的编辑序列,监督这些推出的模型也具有挑战性。
由于编辑可以有很多有效的结果,即使编辑应用正确,该模型在特定转弯时的输出可能与相应的地真图像不同.
因此,在推出过程中后续的编辑被应用于不同于地真序列的图像.
因此,地面真实图像不能成为监督这些编辑的一对目标。

blocks.en:
Inspired by Self-Forcing [ 17 ] , which addresses a similar challenge in autoregressive video generation, we use score distillation to supervise our student model G θ G_{\theta} , which becomes our stable editor after training.
We compute the score-distillation signal using a pretrained flow-matching editor v ϕ v_{\phi} that serves as the teacher.

A key challenge is that the student’s intermediate outputs may contain accumulated errors, making them unreliable inputs for the teacher.
To address this, we introduce asymmetric conditioning of the student and teacher through compound-edit supervision.
While the student applies edits sequentially to its own outputs, the teacher is always conditioned on the original image and a compound instruction combining all edits up to the current turn.
This allows the teacher to provide a training signal that does not inherit the errors accumulated along the student’s trajectory.
blocks.zh:
一个关键挑战是,学生的中间产出可能包含累积错误,使这些错误对教师不可靠。
为了解决这个问题,我们通过综合编辑监督,对学生和教师实行不对称的调节。
虽然学生对自己的产出依次应用编辑,但老师总是以原始图像和组合所有编辑到当前转弯的复合教学为条件.
这使得老师能够提供不继承学生轨迹所积累的错误的训练信号.

blocks.en:
We generate editing rollouts by repeatedly applying the student editor G θ G_{\theta} to its own outputs (left part of Figure 2 ).
Each rollout starts from a source image I 0 I_{0} and a sequence of E E instructions c 1 , … , c E c_{1},\ldots,c_{E} , with E = 10 E=10 during training.
We describe the dataset of instruction sequences in Section 5 .
At turn e e , the editor applies the next instruction c e c_{e} to the completed output from the previous turn: I e = G θ ( I e − 1 , c e ) , e = 1 , … , E . I_{e}=G_{\theta}(I_{e-1},c_{e}),\qquad e=1,\ldots,E. Thus, after the first turn, the editor operates on its own generated images, as it does at inference.

We implement the student with FLUX.2-klein-9B, an image editor that operates in four denoising steps.
We denote the complete four-step editing process by G θ G_{\theta} and a single model prediction within this process by v θ v_{\theta} .
We use the convention where σ = 1 \sigma=1 corresponds to pure noise and σ = 0 \sigma=0 to a clean image, with the predicted velocity pointing toward noise.
At a denoising step with noise level σ \sigma , let x σ x_{\sigma} be the current state.
The model’s prediction provides an estimate of the clean output: x ^ = x σ − σ ​ v θ ​ ( x σ ) \hat{x}=x_{\sigma}-\sigma v_{\theta}(x_{\sigma}) , where,
for brevity, we omit the dependence of v θ v_{\theta} on the noise level, the previous image, and the current instruction.

For a given training rollout, we consider an edit turn e ∈ { 1 , … , E } e\in\{1,\ldots,E\} and a denoising exit step s ∈ { 1 , … , 4 } s\in\{1,\ldots,4\} .
We first obtain I e − 1 I_{e-1} by applying the preceding e − 1 e-1 edits, each using the full four-step denoising process without tracking gradients.
At turn e e , we execute the denoising process up to step s s , where we compute the clean output estimate x ^ e s \hat{x}^{s}_{e} .
Gradients are propagated only through the model’s prediction at this step, without backpropagating through earlier denoising steps or edit turns.
Throughout the rollout, we pass the edited images directly between turns in the model’s latent space, avoiding repeated decoding and encoding.

blocks.en: 4.2 Training

blocks.en:
Having obtained the clean-output estimate x ^ e s \hat{x}^{s}_{e} at turn e e , we now define the training signal.
This signal should encourage adherence to the editing instructions, preservation of relevant image details, and generation of realistic, artifact-free images.
We obtain this signal from a pretrained flow-matching image editor v ϕ v_{\phi} , which serves as our teacher.
Specifically, we evaluate its score on a noisy version of x ^ e s \hat{x}^{s}_{e} at noise level τ \tau , denoted by 𝐳 τ ​ ( x ^ e s ) \mathbf{z}_{\tau}(\hat{x}^{s}_{e}) .
Unlike conventional text-to-image score distillation, our editing teacher is conditioned on both an image and an instruction.
It can therefore guide the output toward results that satisfy the requested edit while preserving relevant details of the conditioning image.

该信号应鼓励遵守编辑指示、保存相关图像细节并生成现实的、无文物的图像。
我们从一个训练有素的相容相容图像编辑器 v \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\

blocks.en:
The remaining question is how to condition the pretrained editing teacher v ϕ v_{\phi} .
Its conditioning image should serve as the source of the edit, while its text input should describe the intended change from that image to x ^ e s \hat{x}^{s}_{e} .
A natural choice is the previous output I e − 1 I_{e-1} and the current instruction c e c_{e} , which are also the inputs to the student G θ G_{\theta} at turn e e .
However, beyond the first turn, I e − 1 I_{e-1} is generated by the student and may already contain artifacts.
This creates a distribution shift for the teacher, which was trained on clean images.
Moreover, since the teacher is expected to preserve details of its conditioning image that are not affected by the instruction, it may also preserve these artifacts rather than correct them.
We examine this conditioning choice in the ablation study in Section 5.4 .

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Our student is FLUX.2-klein-9B [ 25 ] , a 4-step distilled model, which we fine-tune with a LoRA [ 15 ] of rank 16 (27.8M trainable parameters, 0.3% of the model).
The teacher and the auxiliary editor are both FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, the undistilled model of the same family.
The teacher is frozen and uses classifier-free guidance with scale 2.
The auxiliary editor trains its own LoRA of the same size as the student and is not guided.
The student, being distilled, runs without classifier-free guidance, with 4 sampling steps in training rollouts as at inference.
Each training rollout is a chain of 10 edits, and the student’s output latent is passed directly to the next edit, without going through the VAE.
The noise level τ \tau is drawn uniformly over [ 0 , 1 ) [0,1) , independently for every turn, both for the student’s loss and for training the auxiliary editor.
blocks.zh:
我们的学生是FLUX.2-Klein-9B[25],一种由4步蒸馏而成的模型,我们用16级(27.8M可训练参数,占模型的0.3%)的LORA[15]来微调.
教师和辅助编辑都是FLUX.2-克林-碱-9B,是同家族的未分化模型.
老师被冷冻,使用2级无分级指导.
辅助编辑训练自己的LORA与学生大小相同,没有被引导.
学生在被蒸馏后运行时没有无分级指导,在训练推广时有4个采样步骤作为推论.
每次训练推出都是由10个编辑组成的链条,学生的输出潜伏直接传递到下一个编辑,而不经过VAE.
噪音水平 \ tau 被统一画在 [0, 1] [0, 1] 上, 独立为每个回合, 既为学生的损失, 也为培训辅助编辑 。

blocks.en:
The student and the auxiliary editor are optimized with AdamW [ 30 ] ( β = ( 0 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0,0.999) , weight decay 0.01, gradient clipping at 10, bf16), with learning rates of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} for the student and 8 × 10 − 6 8\times 10^{-6} for the auxiliary editor.
We train for 505 iterations: 5 warm-up iterations that update only the auxiliary editor, followed by 500 iterations in which the auxiliary editor is updated at every iteration and the student at every fifth, i.e., 100 student updates.
Training takes about 4.4 GPU-hours on a single NVIDIA B200.
At inference we use the same 4-step unguided sampler.

The inputs for the training rollouts are 96 synthetic 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 images generated with FLUX.2-klein-9B from short scene descriptions. Each image comes with one cumulative chain of 10 edit instructions (960 in total).
All edits are local: each adds, removes, replaces or resizes an object, or changes one of its attributes, such as its color.
Our evaluation benchmark, EdiVal-10 (Sec. 5.3 ), consists of real photographs, so no image is shared between training and evaluation.

所有编辑都是局部的:每个都添加,去除,替换或修改一个对象的大小,或者改变其一个属性,比如它的颜色.
我们的评价基准EdiVal-10(第5.3节)由真实的照片组成,因此培训与评价之间没有共享图像。

blocks.en:
We compare our stable editor with its pretrained backbone model, training-free strategies for reducing multi-turn drift, and a trained multi-turn editor.
Our backbone model baseline is FLUX.2-klein-9B without our fine-tuning, using the same 4-step sampler as our student.
We evaluate Emu Edit’s pixel-thresholding strategy [ 42 ] , VAE-LFA [ 47 ] , and FreqEdit [ 27 ] using the same backbone model.
For Emu Edit, we follow MT-OPSD’s implementation and settings (blur σ = 3 \sigma=3 , threshold α = 0.03 \alpha=0.03 ) [ 61 ] .
For VAE-LFA, we follow its official FLUX.2-klein-9B code, which differs from the paper’s description.
To match our student’s previous-image-only input setting, we port FreqEdit’s official code for the variant that conditions on the previous turn, without the original-source quality guidance of its Kontext version, and use its Kontext settings.
Our model, its backbone model and the training-free methods sample each chain with the same fixed seed, so that their differences come from the method rather than from sampling noise.
We also compare with MT-OPSD [ 61 ] , using its released LoRA on FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, and include the same backbone without this LoRA as its corresponding base-model baseline.
Both use the authors’ inference script and its fixed seed, at 512-pixel resolution, with 30 sampling steps and guidance scale 4; their outputs are upsampled to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 for evaluation.
We fix the seed per chain across all model evaluations.
blocks.zh:
我们把稳定的编辑器与它经过预先训练的骨干模型、减少多轮漂移的无训练战略以及经过训练的多轮编辑器进行比较。
我们的骨干模型基线是FLUX.2-克林-9B 没有我们的微调,使用与我们的学生相同的四步取样器.
我们评价Emu Edit的像素-脉冲策略[42], VAE-LFA[47], FreqEdit[27] 使用相同的主干模型.
对于"Emu Edit",我们遵循MT-OPSD的执行和设置(blur ç = 3\sigma = 3,阈值 α = 0.03\alpha = 0.03) [61].
对于VAE-LFA,我们遵循其官方的FLUX.2-克林-9B代码,这与论文的描述不同.
为了与我们的学生之前的仅图像输入设置相匹配,我们将 FreqEdit 的官方代码移植到在前一回合附加条件的变体,而不使用它的 Kontext 版本的原始源质量指导, 并使用它的 Kontext 设置 。
我们的模型,它的骨干模型和无训练方法用相同的固定种子对每个链条进行取样,这样它们的差异就来自方法而不是取样噪音.
我们还与MT-OPSD[61]进行比较,在FLUX.2-Klein-base-9B上使用其已发布的LORA,并将没有这个LORA的同为主干线作为其相应的基模基线.
两者都使用作者的推论脚本及其固定的种子,以512-像素分辨率,有30个采样步骤和指向尺度4;其输出被被取样到1024×1024-1024\时间进行评价.
我们通过所有模式评价,确定每一条链的种子。

blocks.zh: 5.2 定性评价

Quality is measured by the KRIS-Bench image-quality score of the final image, assigned by a VLM judge (1–5), and by the change in HPSv3 from turn 1 to turn 10.

Editing is measured by the KRIS-Bench instruction-following score at turn 10 (1–5); it checks that stability does not come from skipping edits.
Methods are grouped by backbone; the best result in each column is shown in bold and the second best is underlined. ∗ : significantly different from our model (more than two standard errors, paired over chains).

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : Conditioning ablations. Turns 3, 6, 8 and 9 of a ten-turn editing sequence on a source scene generated with FLUX.2-klein-9B independently of the training data; the instruction below each column is the one applied at that turn.
Our model changes only what each instruction names, and the image stays clean.
The base model degrades the image: it turns yellow and washed out over the turns, and the knitted texture requested for the teddy bear at turn 9 also covers the rocking horse.
Training with a teacher that also sees the previous image does not prevent this degradation: blotchy noise spreads over the walls and the rug from turn to turn.
When the student also sees the source image, earlier edits are undone: the stool made yellow at turn 3 is blue again by turn 6, and the ball made green at turn 6 is red again by turn 8.
blocks.zh:
图 5: 条件障碍。 在FLUX.2-克林-9B生成的源场景上转出3,6,8和9个十回转的编辑序列,独立于训练数据;每列下方的指令是该转出时应用的指令.
我们的模型只改变每个指令名称,图像保持干净。
基型会降解图像:会变出黄色并冲出弯道,为泰迪熊所要求于第9转道的编织纹理也覆盖了摇马.
与一位同样看到上个图像的老师进行训练并不妨碍这种退化:低潮的噪音会蔓延到墙上,地毯从转弯到转弯.
当学生也看到源图像时,更早的编辑被取消:在第3转弯被制成黄色的凳子又被第6转弯被蓝了,在第6转弯被制成绿色的球被第8转弯被再红了.

blocks.en:
Figures 1 and 3 compare our model with its backbone model on editing sequences interspersed with no-op instructions.
We further compare against the training-free methods and MT-OPSD on sequences of consecutive semantic edits in Figure 4 .
The source scenes for these comparisons were generated independently of the training data using FLUX.2-klein-9B.
Figure 4 demonstrates that degradation can accumulate even under simple editing instructions: after ten successive object removals, all competing methods visibly damage the surrounding scene, while our model successfully preserves it.
blocks.zh:
图1和图3将我们的模型与其关于编辑序列的骨干模型相提并论,无操作指令.
我们进一步比较图4中关于连续语义编辑序列的无培训方法和MT-OPSD。
这些比较的源场景是独立于使用FLUX.2-克林-9B的培训数据产生的.
图4显示,即使在简单的编辑指令下,降解也能累积:在连续十次清除物体后,所有相竞方法都明显地损坏了周围的场景,而我们的模型成功保存了它.

blocks.en:
Each training-free method ties every output to part of the previous image, and this is also its main weakness: when an edit has to change exactly that part, content from earlier turns leaks into the result.
Emu Edit reverts pixels that change only slightly, so remnants of earlier images survive; VAE-LFA aligns low-frequency latent statistics with earlier outputs, so their colours persist; and FreqEdit steers high-frequency detail toward the previous image, so their textures persist.
Figure 8 in Appendix F illustrates these effects over three successive background replacements. MT-OPSD leaves no such traces but blurs the image and washes out its colours, consistent with the degradation observed in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh:
每种无训练方法将每个输出都与上个图像的部分联系起来,这也是它的主要弱点:当一个编辑必须精确地改变该部分时,来自更早的内容会变成漏出的结果.
Emu Edit 返回仅稍有变化的像素,因此早期图像的残余能活下来;VAE-LFA 将低频潜在统计数据与更早的输出相协调,因此其颜色持续;而FreqEdit 将高频细节引导到上个图像,因此其纹理持续.
附录中图8 F在连续三次背景替换中说明了这些影响。 MT-OPSD没有留下这样的痕迹,而是模糊了图像并洗去其颜色,与图4所观察到的降解一致.

blocks.en: Further comparisons with the backbone model, including a full sequence of fifteen edits, are shown in Figs. 9 and 10 in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 与主干模型的进一步比较,包括15个编辑的完整序列,以图形式显示。 9和10载于附录。

blocks.en: 5.3 Quantitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.3 定量评价

blocks.en:
Released multi-turn editing benchmarks are short: EdiVal [ 8 ] chains three edits, MagicBrush [ 59 ] at most three, and MSE-Bench [ 39 ] five, too few for drift to build up.
Omni IIE Bench [ 53 ] advertises editing sequences of up to 16 turns, but they average 4.35 turns, and only 9 of its 260 reach ten.
The one benchmark we know of that is built around ten turns, LME-Bench [ 61 ] , contains 100 sessions on synthetic images, and each session opens with a global edit (an art style, a black-and-white or sepia grade, or a change of weather or time of day) and includes three more later. After such a turn, nothing in the image is meant to stay as it was, so unintended changes can no longer be distinguished from those required by the edit through comparison with the source.
We therefore introduce EdiVal-10, in which we extend EdiVal to ten turns of local edits, and report results on LME-Bench in Appendix D .
It contains 252 chains of 10 cumulative edits on real photographs from GEdit-Bench [ 29 ] , center-cropped and resized to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 .
Following EdiVal, a language model lists the objects in each photo using EdiVal’s object-listing prompt, and GroundingDINO [ 28 ] grounds them.
Every edit targets a grounded object and belongs to one of eight local types: add, remove, replace, color, material, text, count, and position.
Each chain also reserves one or two anchor objects that no instruction may edit or mention.
The language model then writes the instructions from a per-chain plan of objects and edit types.
They are checked by rule-based validators and by the language model acting as a critic, and rejected turns are sent back for rewriting.
Every language-model step of its construction uses Claude Sonnet 5.5 [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
已发布的多回合编辑基准短: EdiVal [8] 链条 三版编辑,MagicBrush [59] 最多为 三版,而MSE-Bench [39] 5版,漂移太少而无法累积.
奥姆尼二世 Bench [53] 广告上刊登了最多16个转弯的编辑序列,但平均转弯为4.35个,260个转弯中只有9个达到10个.
我们知道的一个基准是围绕10个转弯构建的,LME-Bench [61],包含100个关于合成图像的会话,每会话以全局编辑(艺术风格,黑白分级或sepia分级,或天气或白天时间的改变)而开场,包括后三会. 如此一转后,画面中的任何内容都无意停留在原地,因此无法再将意想不到的更改与编辑与源相提并论所需的更改区分开来.
因此,我们引入了EdiVal-10, 将EdiVal扩展为十个本地编辑版,
它包含由Gedit-Bench[29]真实相片上10个累积编辑的252个链条,中被剪接并被调整为1024×1024 1024\times 1024.
EdiVal之后,一个语言模型使用EdiVal的对象列表提示来列出每张照片中的对象,GroundingDINO [28] 以此为理由.
每个编辑都针对一个被禁用的对象,属于8个本地类型之一:添加,去除,替换,颜色,材料,文本,计数,以及位置.
每个链条还保留了一到两个无法被指令编辑或引用的锁定对象.
语言模型然后从对象的每链计划中写出指令并编辑类型.
由基于规则的验证人和充当评论家的语言模型来检查,被否决的转折被送回去重写.
其建筑用途的每一个语言模型步骤 克洛德·索内 5.5 [2].

blocks.en:
We score the final image of each chain (turn 10) on three aspects and average over chains. Quality : a VLM judge (Gemma-4-31B [ 12 ] ) rates the image with the image-quality prompt of KRIS-Bench [ 51 ] , and Δ \Delta HPSv3 [ 31 ] measures how much a learned quality estimate changes from turn 1 to turn 10. Preservation : the same judge rates, with the KRIS-Bench consistency prompt, how well everything the instructions do not ask to change is kept; locally, we measure the DINOv2 [ 35 ] distance to the source on the unedited anchor objects and the LPIPS [ 60 ] distance on the background outside all edited objects. Editing : the judge’s KRIS-Bench instruction-following score checks that the requested edits are carried out, so that preservation cannot come from skipping them.
Prompts, masks and the judge’s controls are detailed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
我们在每个链条(第10个转弯)的最后图像分出三个方面,并在链条上取得平均分. 质量:一名VLM法官(Gemma-4-31B [12])用KRIS-Bench的图像质量快取评分图像[51],而\Delta HPSv3[31]衡量从第1回到第10回的学习质量估计变化多少. 保存 : 相同的法官评分, KRIS- Bench 一致性提示, 所有指令不要求更改的都保存得如何好; 我们在当地测量未经编辑的锚物上与源的DINOv2 [35] 距离以及所有编辑对象外的背景上的LPIPS [60] 距离 。 编辑 : 法官的 KRIS- Bench 指令跟随分数检查, 要求的编辑被执行, 这样保存不能来自跳过它们.
提示、口罩和法官的控制措施详见附录B。

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports quality, preservation and editing after ten cumulative edits.
To compare a method with ours, we take the difference between the two on each chain and report the mean difference ± \pm its standard error over the chains; we call a difference significant when it is more than twice its standard error.
blocks.zh:
表1在累计编辑10次后报告质量,保存和编辑情况.
为了与我们的方法进行比较,我们将每个链上两者的相差,并报告其相对于链上的标准差 ±\pm;当其标准差的两倍以上时,我们称之为显著的差.

blocks.en:
Our method produces the highest-quality final images: its KRIS quality score is significantly higher than that of every other method, the smallest margin being over Emu Edit ( 0.30 ± 0.08 0.30\pm 0.08 ). This result is aligned with the qualitative results in Figure 4 .
Emu Edit’s Δ \Delta HPSv3 does not differ significantly from ours ( − 0.15 -0.15 vs. − 0.17 -0.17 ), and its visual artifacts are demonstrated in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh:
我们的方法产生出质量最高的最终图像:它的KRIS质量分数明显高于所有其他方法,最小的比值是"Emu Edit"(0.30±0.08 0.30\pm 0.08). 这一结果与图4的质量结果一致。
Emu Edit的 \\ Delta HPSv3 与我们的没有显著区别(0.15-0.15 vs. −0.17-0.17),其可视文物如图4所示。

blocks.en:
Judged on the whole image, our method makes the fewest unintended changes: its KRIS consistency score is 3.85, compared with 3.04 to 3.32 for the training-free methods, 3.03 for the base model and 1.29 for MT-OPSD.
On the background, our method attains the lowest LPIPS distance (0.254), a massive improvement over the base model at 0.351. Compared to our method, every other method is worse, Emu Edit by the smallest margin (0.264; + 0.010 ± 0.005 +0.010\pm 0.005 , t = 2.1 t=2.1 ).
On the anchor objects, our method and Emu Edit attain the lowest DINOv2 distances (0.203 and 0.196; the difference, − 0.007 ± 0.012 -0.007\pm 0.012 , is not significant), while all other methods are significantly worse than ours.
Emu Edit is comparable to our method only on two local metrics, not on whole-image consistency; our model matches or exceeds it on both without copying pixels.
blocks.zh:
从整个图像来看,我们的方法作出最少的意外改变:它的KRIS一致性分数为3.85分,而无训练方法的分数为3.04分至3.32分,基数模型为3.03分,MT-OPSD为1.29分.
在背景上,我们的方法达到了最低的LPIPS距离(0.254),比起基础模型的0.351大幅改进. 相较于我们的方法,其他方法都更糟了,"Emu Edit"以最小比值(0.264;+0.010±0.005+0.010\pm0.005,t=2.1t=2.1.
在锚地物体上,我们的方法和Emu Edit达到了最低的DINOv2距离(0.203和0.196;差值为-0.007±0.012-0.07/pm0.012,并不显著),而所有其他方法都比我们的差很多。
Emu Edit只在两个本地度量标准上与我们的方法相比,而不是在全图像一致性上;我们的模型在两个度量标准上匹配或超过,而不复制像素.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Ablations on EdiVal-10. Each row changes one aspect of our model; all variants are trained for 100 student updates and evaluated after 10 cumulative edits on all 252 chains (the anchor distance on the 148 chains whose anchor object lies mostly outside the edited objects; Appendix B ). ∗ : significantly different from our model (more than two standard errors, paired over chains).
blocks.zh: 表2:EdiVal-10上的缩写。 每行都改变我们模型的一个方面;所有变体都经过培训,供100名学生更新,并在所有252个链条(148个链条上锚定距离,其锚定对象大多位于被编辑的对象外;附录B.)上累计编辑10个后进行评估. *:与我们的模型有很大不同(超过两个标准错误,在链条上对接).

blocks.en:
The gains in quality and preservation do not come at the expense of instruction following, with instruction-following scores remaining comparable.
On the KRIS-Bench instruction-following score, our method (3.38) does not differ significantly from the highest-scoring method, FreqEdit (3.39), and scores significantly higher than MT-OPSD (3.16) and its base model (3.10).
blocks.zh:
质量和保全方面的收益并不以牺牲以下教学为代价,随从教学的分数仍然相当。
在KRIS-Bench指令-跟随得分上,我们的方法(3.38)与最高得分方法FreqEdit(3.39)没有显著区别,得分明显高于MT-OPSD(3.16)及其基数模式(3.10).

blocks.en:
Stability over many turns should not come at the cost of single edits.
We therefore also apply each method once to each of the 606 English instructions of GEdit-Bench [ 29 ] and measure the change in HPSv3 from the source to the edited image (Appendix E ).
A single edit lowers HPSv3 for every method, and least for ours: by 0.18, against 0.41 for the base model ( 0.23 ± 0.02 0.23\pm 0.02 ), while every other method loses significantly more.
blocks.zh:
在许多弯道上保持稳定不应以单一编辑为代价。
因此,我们也将每种方法一次地应用到Gedit-Bench的606英文指令中,并测量HPSv3从源到被编辑的图像的变化(Appendix E.
单一编辑将HPSv3降低到每种方法,对我们来说最少:以0.18比0.41降低到基础模型(0.23±0.02 0.23\pm 0.02),而所有其他方法都损失显著.

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.4 读取研究

blocks.en:
We evaluate the role of asymmetric conditioning on EdiVal-10 by varying the inputs provided to the teacher, auxiliary editor, and student, and the length of the training rollouts.
The teacher and auxiliary editor receive identical conditioning in all variants.
All variants are trained for 100 student updates.
Table 2 reports the quantitative results, and Figure 5 illustrates the conditioning variants qualitatively.
blocks.zh:
我们通过向教师、辅助编辑和学生提供不同投入以及培训时间长短来评价EdiVal-10上的不对称调节的作用。
教师和辅助编辑在所有变体中都得到相同的调制.
所有变体都为100个学生更新而训练.
表2报告了定量结果,图5从质量上说明了各种条件变量。

blocks.en:
Our teacher and auxiliary editor are conditioned on the original image and the compound instruction, anchoring score distillation to the clean source.
We compare this design with two alternatives: additionally providing the previous student output to both models, and replacing the original image and compound instruction with the previous output and current instruction.
Both alternatives substantially reduce preservation: consistency drops from 3.85 to 2.81 and 2.28, respectively, compared with 3.03 for the pretrained base model.
Figure 5 illustrates the former variant: as with the base model, the image degrades over the turns, and blotchy noise spreads over the walls and the rug.
These results suggest that conditioning the score models on intermediate student outputs can reinforce accumulated artifacts rather than correct them.
blocks.zh:
我们的老师和辅助编辑以原始图像和复合教学为条件,将分数分数放入清洁源.
我们把这种设计与两种备选方法相提并论:另外向两种模型提供之前的学生产出,并用之前的输出和当前教学取代原来的图像和复合教学.
这两种替代品都大大减少了保存:一致性分别从3.85降至2.81和2.28,而预先训练的基模为3.03。
图5说明了前一种变体:同基座模型一样,图像会从转弯处降解出,而模糊的噪音会从墙壁和地毯上扩散出.
这些结果表明,将分数模型限定在中学生产出上可以强化所积累的文物,而不是加以纠正。

blocks.en:
Our student receives only the previous output and current instruction.
Providing the original image as an additional reference improves consistency from 3.85 to 4.08, but reduces instruction following from 3.38 to 2.80.
As shown in Figure 5 , earlier edits are undone as later ones are applied: the recoloured stool and ball return to their original colours.
Thus, stronger preservation of the source does not necessarily imply successful multi-turn editing.
Our asymmetric design maintains both scene consistency and the changes introduced across successive turns.
blocks.zh:
我们的学生只接受前期产出和当前教学。
提供原始图像作为补充参考,可提高一致性,从3.85到4.08,但将指令从3.38减少到2.80。
如图5所示,早期的编辑随着后期的编辑被取消:重排的凳子和球回回原色.
因此,加强保护资料来源并不一定意味着成功的多回合编辑。
我们的不对称设计既保持了场景的一致性,也保持了相继转弯所引入的变化.

blocks.en:
We train on rollouts of 10 edits, the same length as the evaluated sequences.
A student trained on 5-edit rollouts still improves over the base model after ten turns (consistency 3.29 vs. 3.03), but recovers only about a third of our gain (3.85) and is significantly worse than our model on every preservation measure.
Training on its own outputs over the full length of the sequences it edits at inference is therefore important.
blocks.zh:
我们进行10个编辑的训练,长度与评估的序列相同。
接受过5版推出培训的学生在10个转会(一致性3.29对3.03)后,仍然比基准模式有所改进,但只恢复了我们收益的约三分之一(3.85),并且比每一次保全措施的模型要糟糕得多。
因此,重要的是,要根据自己在推断中编辑的全部序列,对自己的产出进行培训。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions, Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论、限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Limitations. We show selected steps from a nine-edit sequence.
Both the base model and ours follow the final instruction “Make the hiker smile,”
but also remove the sunglasses added in a previous edit.
While our method reduces accumulated drift, it inherits the editing capabilities and limitations of the base model.
blocks.zh:
图6:限制。 我们显示从一个九版序列中选择的步骤。
基地模式和我们的模式都遵循“让徒步者微笑”的最后指示。
但同时也去除先前编辑中添加的太阳镜。
虽然我们的方法减少了累积漂移,但它继承了基础模型的编辑能力和局限性.

blocks.en:
We introduced a training approach for stable multi-turn image editing.
Our central idea is that stability should be learned over the entire
recursive process, rather than at individual editing steps. We achieve
this through asymmetric conditioning : the student learns from
its own generated editing trajectories, while the teacher remains
anchored to the original clean image and the accumulated editing
instructions. This allows us to supervise a long, imperfect sequence
of edits through a shorter, clean alternative path, without exposing
the teacher to the errors accumulated by the student.
blocks.zh:
我们采用了一种培训方法来进行稳定的多回合图像编辑。
我们的中心思想是,应该从整体上学习稳定
递归过程,而不是单个编辑步骤. 我们实现了
通过不对称条件: 学生从
它自己产生的编辑轨迹,而老师仍然
锁定到原始的干净图像和累积的编辑
说明。 这样我们就可以监督一个长而不完美的序列
编辑,不暴露
老师对学生积累的错误。

blocks.en:
Interestingly, multi-turn editing does not always lead to degradation.
When edits repeatedly replace the subject and background, existing
models can maintain visual quality even over long sequences
(Fig. 7 ). We attribute this to the fact that
such edits generate new content rather than preserving existing
details. In contrast, edits that require content to persist across
many turns are more susceptible to accumulated errors. Our work
therefore focuses on sequences in which unaffected content must
remain consistent.
blocks.zh:
有趣的是,多回合编辑并不总是导致退化.
当编辑反复替换主题和背景时,已有
模型即使在长序列中也能保持视觉质量
(图7). 我们将此归咎于
这种编辑生成了新的内容,而不是保留现有的
细节。 对比之下,要求内容贯穿的编辑
许多转弯更容易发生累积错误。 我们的工作
因此,重点应放在未受影响的内容必须遵循的顺序上。
保持不变。

blocks.en:
Our approach substantially reduces accumulated drift, but
some challenges remain. Particularly difficult editing instructions may
still affect previously edited content
(Fig. 6 ), suggesting that stability
and instruction following are related but distinct objectives.
Furthermore, although our method improves stability beyond
the sequence lengths seen during training, extending this
robustness to much longer editing sequences remains an
interesting direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法大大减少了累积的漂移,但
一些挑战依然存在。 特别困难的编辑指令可能
仍然影响先前编辑的内容
(图6),表明稳定
下述指示是相关但明确的目标。
此外,尽管我们的方法提高了稳定度
训练中看到的序列长度, 扩展此长度
稳健到更长的编辑序列仍然是一种
未来工作的有趣方向。

blocks.en:
Beyond image editing, our approach suggests a more general training
principle for recursive generative processes. Self-Forcing exposes
the model to the distribution it will encounter during inference,
while asymmetric teacher supervision provides reliable guidance
from a clean reference. Score distillation connects these two
paths without requiring paired target outputs, which is particularly
useful when many valid results are possible. We believe this
combination may be useful in other generative tasks where models
repeatedly operate on their own outputs.
blocks.zh:
除了图像编辑之外,我们的方法建议进行更一般的培训
遗传过程原则。 自我强制暴露
在推论中将遇到的分布模型,
教师监督的不对称提供了可靠的指导
从一个干净的参考。 分数蒸馏连接这两个
路径不需要配对目标产出,特别是
当可能取得许多有效结果时有用。 我们相信
组合对于模型中的其他遗传性任务可能有用
经常使用自己的产出。

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价计量

blocks.en:
All metrics are computed at the final turn (turn 10) of each EdiVal-10 chain and averaged over chains; comparisons between methods are paired over chains and reported with standard errors.
The three judged scores use the prompts of KRIS-Bench [ 51 ] unchanged, with Gemma-4-31B [ 12 ] as the judge in place of GPT-4o.
blocks.zh:
所有衡量标准都在每个EdiVal-10链的最后转折(第10转折)进行计算,并在链上进行平均;方法之间的比较在链上进行对接并报告标准出错。
三个评分使用KRIS-Bench[51]的提示,没有改变,由Gemma-4-31B[12]担任评分,取而代之的是GPT-4o.

blocks.en: EdiVal-10 draws its chains only from GEdit-Bench photographs whose short side is at least 768 pixels, so the center crop and resize to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 upsamples a source by at most 1.33 × 1.33\times .
blocks.zh: EdiVal-10只从短边至少为768像素的Gedit-Bench相片中取出链条,因此中心收成并被调整为1024×1024 1024\times 1024\times 1024\times在最多1.33×1.33\times的基础上提升了源头.

blocks.en:
The judge rates the final image with the image-quality prompt, checking structural coherence, natural appearance, absence of artifacts and texture fidelity, and yielding a score from 1 to 5.
The prompt describes every image as AI-generated, and on our real photographs the judge also reports defects in untouched sources (their mean score is 3.57); since all methods are scored on the same photographs and compared chain by chain, this affects the absolute scores but not the comparisons. Δ \Delta HPSv3 is the change in HPSv3 [ 31 ] , a learned estimate of perceived image quality, from the first edited image (turn 1) to the final image.
Measuring from turn 1 rather than from the source separates the quality lost over the chain from the effect of a single edit.
blocks.zh:
评委将最终图像评为图像质量快取,检查结构一致性,自然外观,缺少文物和纹理忠贞,得分从1分到5分.
该提示将每个图像描述为AI生成的,在我们的真实照片上,法官还报告未触动源的缺陷(其平均分为3.57分);因为所有方法都在同一相片上打分并按链条比较,这影响了绝对分数,而不是比较. QQ\Delta HPSv3是HPSv3 [31]中的变化,是对所感知到的图像质量的学识估计,从第一个被编辑的图像(第1回)到最终的图像.
从第1回而不是从源头来衡量,将链条上损失的质量与单一编辑的效果区分开来.

blocks.en:
On the whole image, the judge rates consistency with the source using the visual-consistency prompt.
It sees the source, the final image and the chain’s ten instructions as one numbered list, and scores from 1 to 5 how well everything the instructions do not ask to change is preserved (5: all such elements unchanged; 1: most of the scene altered).
As controls, on the first 20 EdiVal-10 chains it scores each source compared with itself 5, and each source compared with the final image of a different chain 1.
Locally, we measure each chain’s anchor objects, which no instruction edits or mentions (Sec. 5.3 ).
We crop the box of each anchor from the source and from the final image, grey out in both crops the parts that fall inside the box of any edited object, and compute the DINOv2 [ 35 ] distance (one minus the cosine similarity of the CLS features) between the two crops.
Because the boxes are coarse, an anchor can lie largely inside the box of an edited object (e.g., a shirt worn by a person who is edited), leaving too little of it to compare.
We therefore use an anchor only if at least 30% of its box remains after the masking, and take a chain’s anchor distance as the mean over its usable anchors; 148 of the 252 chains have at least one, and the anchor distance is averaged over these chains.
We also compute LPIPS [ 60 ] between the source and the final image over the background, i.e., the whole image outside the boxes of all edited objects (a median of 57% of the image).
Added objects are placed in this region, so the background distance should be read together with the instruction-following score.
blocks.zh:
在整个图像上,法官使用视觉相容性快取来评分与源一致.
它将源头、最终图像和链条的10个指令视为一个编号列表,并将指令不要求更改的每件事都保存得如何好评分(5个:所有此类要素不变;1个场景大部分被更改)。
作为控件,在前20个EdiVal-10链上,它比起自己5对每个源进行分数,而每个源比起不同的一链的最终图像.
在本地,我们测量每个链条的锁定对象,没有指示编辑或提及(第5.3节)。
我们从源头和最后的图像来裁剪每个锚的盒子,在两种作物中灰出任何被编辑物体的盒子内部分,并计算出两种作物之间的DINOv2[35]相距(一个减去CLS特征的同心圆相近性).
由于盒子很粗糙,一个锚可以大致躺在被编辑对象的盒子内(例如被编辑者所穿的衬衫),留下的太少,无法比较.
因此,只有在蒙面后至少保留了30 % 的锚并取出一条链的锚距作为可用锚的平均值时,我们才使用锚;252个链中148个至少有一个,锚距平均取自这些链上。
我们还计算出来源和背景上的最后图像之间的LPIPS [60],即所有被编辑对象的框外的整幅图像(中位数为图像的57%).
添加的对象被放置在这个区域,因此背景距离应该与指令后分数一起阅读.

blocks.en:
A model can preserve content trivially by not editing, so we check that the requested edits are carried out and survive the chain.
The judge applies the instruction-following prompt: it sees the source, the final image and the chain’s ten instructions as one numbered list, and scores from 1 to 5 whether the requested changes are present and correct (5: all present and accurate; 3: partially; 1: not at all), leaving unrequested changes to the consistency score.
As a negative control, showing the source image instead of the final image yields a score of 1 for all 20 chains.
blocks.zh:
一个模型可以通过不编辑来轻而易举地保存内容,所以我们检查所请求的编辑是否完成并活过链条.
法官应用遵循指令的提示:将源、最终图像和链条的10个指令视为一个编号列表,并将要求的更改从1到5分(5分:全部是现在和准确的;3分:部分;1分:根本不是),使一致性分数没有要求的更改。
作为一种负控,显示源图像而不是最终图像,所有20个链条都得分1分.

and a dog in a living room. We show the first, fifth, and tenth cycles
of this sequential rollout. Visual quality remains coherent at late

Replacing both the subject and background every two turns limits

does not necessarily lead to progressive visual degradation.

blocks.en:
To distinguish sequence length from long-term preservation demands, we
consider a 40-edit sequence produced by the unmodified distilled
FLUX.2 Klein 9B model ( Fig. 7 ). Starting from a dog in a
living room, we repeat four edits ten times: replace the dog with a cat,
move the scene to a beach, replace the cat with a dog, and move the scene
back to a living room. The subject and background are each replaced every
two turns, so neither must retain its original details throughout the sequence.
The outputs remain visually coherent through turn 40, without an obvious
progressive loss of visual quality. However, the animal’s appearance and the
room layout vary across cycles; returning to the same semantic categories
does not imply recovery of the original image. This qualitative example
shows that a long editing sequence need not exhibit progressive degradation
when content is repeatedly replaced, and motivates evaluating stability in
settings that require content to persist across many edits.
blocks.zh:
为了区分序列长度和长期保存要求,我们
考虑未经修改的蒸馏器产生的40个编辑序列
FLUX.2 克莱因9B型号(图7. 从狗入手

两次转弯,所以也不必在整个序列中保留其原始细节.
通过第40轮,产出在视觉上保持连贯性,没有明显的
逐渐失去视觉质量。 然而,动物的外表和
房间布局因周期而异;返回相同的语义类别
并不意味着恢复原始图像。 这一定性实例
显示长的编辑序列不需要显示逐渐退化
当内容被反复替换时,并激励评估稳定性
需要在许多编辑中坚持内容的设置。

blocks.en: Appendix D Results on LME-Bench
blocks.zh: 附录D 关于LME-Bench的结果

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports results on LME-Bench [ 61 ] (Sec. 5.3 ) in MT-OPSD’s format.
We score it with MT-OPSD’s evaluation code, using Gemma-4-31B in place of GPT-4o as for our other judged metrics, and show every image to the judge at 512 pixels.
A turn succeeds if the judge rates both its instruction following and its consistency above 6 out of 10; the success rate (SR) at turn k k is the share of the 100 sessions whose turns 1 to k k all succeed.
The collapse rate (CR) at turn k k is the share of sessions in which, by turn k k , two consecutive turns have been judged destroyed (severe content loss or surface corruption relative to the source).
MT-OPSD and its base model are sampled as in Sec. 5.1 , without upsampling; we run our model and its base model with their own 4-step sampler, also generating at 512 pixels and passing each turn’s output image to the next turn.
Absolute numbers depend on the judge: MT-OPSD reports an SR at turn 10 of 0.38 for its FLUX model under GPT-4o, against 0.10 under our judge, so Table 3 is not comparable with the numbers reported in [ 61 ] .
blocks.zh:
表3以MT-OPSD的格式报告LME-Bench[61](第5.3条)。
我们用MT-OPSD的评价代码来评分,用Gemma-4-31B来代替GPT-4o来评分我们的其他衡量标准,并以512像素向评委展示每个图像.
如果法官按其指示进行评分,且其一致性超过10分之6,则转会成功;转会成功率(SR)为100会中1至k的分会成功率。
转出kk的倒塌率(CR)是通过转出kk判断连续两个转出被破坏的会话份额(相对于源头而言,严重的内容损失或地表腐败).
MT-OPSD及其基础模型的样本如Sec. 5.1所示,没有进行抽样;我们用自己的四步取样器运行我们的模型及其基础模型,同样生成512像素,并将每个转弯的输出图像传递到下个转弯.
绝对数字取决于法官:MT-OPSD在GPT-4o下的FLUX模型的第10回为0.38,而我们的法官为0.10,因此表3与[61]中报告的数字不相上下。

blocks.en:
Our model completes all ten turns in 53 of the 100 sessions, against 10 for MT-OPSD, and collapses in 2, against 16.
Most of this gap comes from the backbone and its sampler, as our base model already completes 49 sessions.
Compared with it, our model succeeds significantly more often at turns 5 and 8, but not at turn 10 (0.53 vs. 0.49), and the base model rarely collapses on this benchmark (0.04 at turn 10), leaving little room for improvement.
At 1024 pixels, the resolution of our other experiments, the two are tied in every column (SR at turn 10: 0.53 vs. 0.46).

blocks.en: Appendix E Single Edits
blocks.zh: 附录E 单一编辑

blocks.en:
Every training rollout starts with an ordinary single edit (Sec. 4 ), but the training targets long sequences, so we check that stability does not come at the cost of single-edit quality.
We apply each method once to every English instruction of GEdit-Bench [ 29 ] : 606 instructions over 604 photographs, in eleven edit types that include global edits such as style and tone changes.
The photographs keep their aspect ratio.
Our model, its base model and the training-free methods generate at the photograph’s resolution, capped at about one megapixel; MT-OPSD and its base model generate at about 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels with the authors’ script, and their change is measured from the source at that resolution.
We measure the change in HPSv3 from the source to the edited image, with the same HPSv3 settings as in Table 1 , and average it over the instructions (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh:
每次训练的推出都从普通的单一编辑开始(sec. 4),但训练的目标都是长序列,所以我们检查稳定性不会以单一编辑质量为代价.
我们把每一种方法都应用到 Gedit-Bench [29]: 606 个指令,超过 604 个相片, 分为十一个编辑类型, 包括全局编辑, 如风格和语气变化 。
这些相片保持了相片的尺寸比.
我们的模型、其基础模型和无训练方法在照片的分辨率上产生,封顶大约为一兆像素;MT-OPSD及其基础模型产生大约512×512 512\times 512像素并带有作者的脚本,其变化是从这个分辨率的源头测出.
我们测量HPSv3从源到被编辑的图像的变化,其HPSv3的设置与表1相同,并平均于指令(表4).

blocks.en:
A single edit lowers HPSv3 for every method, and least for our model: by 0.18, against 0.41 for its base model (difference 0.23 ± 0.02 0.23\pm 0.02 ).
Every other method also loses significantly more than our model, MT-OPSD the most (0.75).
VAE-LFA aligns each output with earlier outputs and does not act on the first edit, so on single edits it is identical to the base model.
blocks.zh:
单一编辑将HPSv3降低到每种方法,对我们的模型来说最少:以0.18比0.41降低到0.23±0.02 0.23\pm 0.02.
所有其他方法也都比我们的模型,MT-OPSD损失最大(0.75).
VAE-LFA将每个输出都与更早的输出相配合,在第一次编辑时不起作用,因此在单一编辑时与基准模型完全相同.

blocks.en: Appendix F Successive Background Changes
blocks.zh: 附录 背景变化

blocks.en:
Figure 8 : Successive background changes. Each training-free method carries part of an earlier background into the next turn.
The teddy bear, alarm clock and toy train of a synthetic scene are placed in a lavender field at sunset (edit 1), in front of a red brick wall (edit 2), and on a smooth gradient backdrop from warm cream to light grey (edit 3).
Our model keeps the three objects and gives a clean gradient.
Emu Edit keeps the low, warm light of the sunset in front of the brick wall (edit 2), and at edit 3 leaves a clump of lavender stalks on the floor of the gradient backdrop and turns the blue train grey.
VAE-LFA keeps the colour of the sunset: at edit 3 the whole image has a purple-magenta cast, the bear turns reddish and the clock face pink.
FreqEdit prints the pattern of the brick wall into the smooth gradient.
MT-OPSD leaves no trace of the earlier backgrounds but blurs the image and washes out its colours.

图8:相继的背景变化。 每种无培训方法都包含部分较早的背景,进入下一个回合。
合成场景的泰迪熊,闹钟和玩具列车被放入日出时的薰衣草地上(第1版),红砖墙前(第2版),从暖奶油到淡灰色的平滑梯度背景上(第3版).
我们的模型保存着三个物体 并给出一个干净的梯度。
Emu Edit在砖墙前(第2版)保留了低温的夕阳光芒,在编辑3时会把一团紫外线花在梯度背景的地上,使蓝色的火车变灰.
VAE-LFA保持了夕阳的颜色: 在编辑3时,整个图像有紫色-magenta的铸造,熊会变红并时钟会面对粉红色.
FreqEdit将砖墙的图案打印为平滑梯度.
MT-OPSD没有留下早期背景的痕迹,而是模糊了图像并洗去其颜色.

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the example discussed in Sec. 5.2 : three successive background changes, in which each training-free method carries part of the previous image into the next one.
blocks.zh: 图8显示了第5.2节所讨论的例子:连续三次背景变化,其中每个无训练方法将上个图像的一部分带入下个图像.

blocks.en:
Figure 9 : Additional multi-turn image editing results. We show selected turns from 20-step editing sequences.
Each displayed instruction is followed by four no-op instructions
(“keep the image as is”), and the images show the results after
those no-ops.
While the original FLUX.2 Klein accumulates color shifts and loses
detail, fine-tuning it with our training paradigm (+Ours) yields
a more stable editing process, preserving the scene and prior edits
while following the requested changes.

每个显示的指令后面有四个禁用指令
(“保持图像原样”),图像显示以下结果:
那些无头人。
原本的FLUX.2 Klein 累积了颜色变化并丢失
细节,根据我们的培训模式(+我们的)产量加以调整
更稳定的编辑进程,保存场景和以前的编辑
在要求的修改之后。

blocks.en:
Figure 10 : Fifteen consecutive semantic edits. We compare the original FLUX.2 Klein with our fine-tuned model
(+Ours) over a sequence of 15 edits.
Each result becomes the input to the next edit.
Our method reduces accumulated drift in color and scene details
while retaining the original model’s ability to follow diverse
editing instructions, including object additions, removals,
and pose and expression changes.
blocks.zh:

每个结果成为下一个编辑的输入.
我们的方法减少了在颜色和场景细节上累积的漂移
保留原模型遵循多样性的能力
编辑指令,包括对象添加、清除、
并改变姿势和表达方式。
